The method involves multiple interacting physical models (field emission, ionization, elastic escape, electrostatic transport) and careful numerical integration, which goes beyond standard library calls and requires genuine understanding of the paper's approach.

This requires multi-tool orchestration (e.g., custom code and possibly SIMION-like package) and non-trivial data handling, making it a fragile, moderately long workflow.
